correctness.rationale: For each Jordan periodic orbit about the anchored origin, composing with a global C1 diffeomorphism multiplies the signed winding number by its common global orientation sign. The angular-speed defect is the angular projection of DF times the model generator residual, bounded by M epsilon/(m r_i). Integrating over each primitive period and eliminating the single reference speed yields exactly (m/M)r1r2/(r1+r2)|omega1-omega2|. Every quantifier and the case of orientation reversal are handled. A polynomial center with circle radii 1,2 and angular speeds 2,5 saturates the bound at reference angular speed 4. The 65 deterministic exact-rational checker assertions corroborate the special examples, not the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: For a genuinely nonisochronous center, the reference architecture either learns amplitude-dependent frequency, permits ill-conditioning, or retains a quantitatively irreducible generator error on multiple cycles. The exact lower constant uses measurable physical periods and radii, and the smooth polynomial equality case proves it is not merely a qualitative non-representability claim. The result supplies a parameter-dependent structural diagnostic for conditioned smooth flow conjugacies rather than an isolated sign or normalization check.
